Description.TranslatedText: The terminology relevant to whether biospecimens were retained and contain DNA within an observational study.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: An indication that no biospecimen samples were retained.
An indication that the retained biospecimens contain DNA.
An indication that the retained biospecimens do not contain DNA.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Retained Specimens Do Not Contain DNA

CodeList.CDISCSynonym: Observational Study Biospecimen Retention
CodeList.PreferredTerm: CDISC SDTM Observational Study Biospecimen Retention Terminology

CodeList.Name: Observational Study Model

Description.TranslatedText: The terminology relevant to the trial design for observational studies.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: A study that compares groups of people with generally similar characteristics, those with the condition under study (case) and those without the condition under study (control).

A study in which the subject characteristics of the case, immediately prior to disease onset (sometimes called the hazard period), are compared to characteristics of same case at a prior time (i.e., control period). (ClinicalTrials.gov)
A study in which the subject with the condition under study (the case) is compared against a theoretical/historical model of distribution that serves as a control.
A study in which subjects are grouped based on a predefined personal or administrative characteristic.
A study in which geographically distinct study populations are compared with respect to a particular outcome.
A study in which related or non-related family members are compared with respect to a particular outcome.

CodeList.CDISCSynonym: Observational Study Model
CodeList.PreferredTerm: CDISC SDTM Observational Study Model Terminology

CodeList.Name: Observational Study Sampling Method

Description.TranslatedText: The terminology relevant to the method by which the study population is selected in an observational study.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: A non-random process used to select a study population in which the participants have been selected based on convenience or with a particular purpose in mind.

An exclusively random process to guarantee that each participant or population has specified chance of selection, such as simple random sampling, systematic sampling, stratified random sampling, cluster sampling, and consecutive patient sampling. (clinicaltrials.gov)

CodeList.CDISCSynonym: Observational Study Sampling Method
CodeList.PreferredTerm: CDISC SDTM Observational Study Sampling Method Terminology

CodeList.Name: Observational Study Time Perspective

Description.TranslatedText: The terminology relevant to the temporal relationship between the observation period and time of subject enrollment in an observational study.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: Studies in which observations or measurements made at a single point in time, usually at subject enrollment. (clinicaltrials.gov)
Studies that look forward using periodic observations collected predominantly following subject enrollment. (clinicaltrials.gov)
Studies that look back using observations collected predominantly prior to subject selection and enrollment. (clinicaltrials.gov)

CodeList.CDISCSynonym: Observational Study Time Perspective
CodeList.PreferredTerm: CDISC SDTM Observational Study Time Perspective Terminology

CodeList.Name: Oncology Response Assessment Result

Description.TranslatedText: Terminology for oncology studies relevant to the result of response to treatment or therapy assessment within the disease response and clinical classification domain.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The absence of change in the overall attenuation of the metastasis and in the peripheral rim, suggesting a lack of response to treatment.
The amount of cancer antigen 125 is reduced by 50% from protocol-defined baseline value(s).
The amount of cancer antigen 125 is reduced by 75% from protocol-defined baseline value(s).
The disappearance of all signs of cancer based on physical exam, such as palpation.

The disappearance of cancer in response to treatment, including platelet and white blood cell counts returning to normal levels, a non-palpable spleen, and no immature white blood cells present in the blood unless it is a regenerating marrow following treatment.
The disappearance of metabolic tumor activity in all relevant lesions.
Absence of residual disease based on pre-defined thresholds and minimal residual disease negativity by laboratory techniques.
A decrease in the size and the extent of tissue involvement by cancer, based on physical exam, such as palpation.
The disappearance of all signs of cancer in response to treatment. (NCI)
The disappearance of all signs of cancer, based on CT scan and criteria-defined assessments.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Complete Remission with Incomplete Blood Count Recovery
Complete Response with Incomplete Bone Marrow Recovery
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The disappearance of all signs of cancer in response to treatment accompanied by incomplete bone marrow recovery, as evidenced by persistent anemia, thrombocytopenia or neutropenia.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Complete Response with Incomplete Bone Marrow Recovery

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The disappearance of all signs of cancer, including the absence of a detectable disease-related genetic abnormality, as determined by techniques such as karyotyping or FISH, in response to treatment.
A minimal decrease in abnormal karyotype, based on pre-defined thresholds.
A minor decrease in abnormal karyotype, based on pre-defined thresholds.
No change in abnormal karyotype, based on pre-defined thresholds.
A partial decrease in abnormal karyotype, based on pre-defined thresholds.
Made less in size, amount, degree, or extent.
A conversion from one disease diagnosis to another, which may be considered a progression to a worsening state.
Open to question.
No new lesions(s) and a decrease in lesion size, or a reduction in central necrosis or attenuation in one or more enhancing lesions, based on pre-defined thresholds.
An improvement in erythrocyte count as a response to treatment.
An improvement of neutrophil count as a response to treatment.
An improvement of platelet count as a response to treatment.
Radiographic progression which has been confirmed by additional imaging showing worsening of initial progression.
The disappearance of all signs of cancer following an initial apparent radiographic progression.

The disappearance of all signs of cancer, supported by the absence of phenotypically aberrant plasma cells (clonal) in bone marrow. (Rajkumar SV, Harousseau J, Durie B et al, Consensus recommendations for the uniform reporting of clinical trials: report of the International Myeloma Workshop Consensus Panel 1. Blood. 2011; 117(18):4691-4695)
A subjective response indicating that something has improved or gotten better.
A process of becoming larger, more intense, more extensive, more numerous, more important, or more likely.
A response that is neither favorable nor unfavorable.
A finding indicating that there is a decrease based on a predetermined threshold in the size and the extent of tissue involvement by cancer following an initial apparent radiographic progression.
Cancer that is neither decreasing nor increasing in extent or severity based on predetermined boundaries following an initial apparent radiographic progression.
Apparent radiographic progression which requires confirmation, per criteria, with additional imaging.
A major decrease in signs of cancer, supported by pathological examination and based on pre-defined thresholds.
A decrease in the number of bone marrow plasma cells to protocol-defined level(s).
A minor decrease in signs of cancer, supported by pathological examination and based on pre-defined thresholds.
The disappearance of all signs of cancer, supported by molecular analysis.
A decrease in signs of cancer, supported by molecular analysis.
The disappearance of all signs of cancer, supported by morphological analysis.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Morphologic Complete Remission with Incomplete Blood Count Recovery
Morphologic Complete Remission with Incomplete Bone Marrow Recovery
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The disappearance of all cells with morphologic characteristics of cancer, accompanied by incomplete bone marrow recovery, as evidenced by persistent anemia, thrombocytopenia or neutropenia.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Morphologic Complete Remission with Incomplete Blood Count Recovery

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The disappearance of all cells with morphologic characteristics of leukemia, accompanied by bone marrow recovery, in response to treatment. Hematologic recovery is not required. Leukemia free state can be a hypocellular marrow.

A finding that refers to hematologic and solid malignancies and indicates that there is a minor improvement in the measures of disease burden, meeting a predetermined threshold, but not meeting partial response criteria.
Absence of minimal residual disease based on laboratory techniques.
Presence of residual disease based on pre-defined thresholds and quantifiable minimal residual disease positivity by laboratory techniques.
Presence of residual disease based on pre-defined thresholds and return of quantifiable minimal residual disease positivity after a period of minimal residual disease negativity.
Unable to be evaluated. (NCI)
An absence of detectable disease.
Persistence of one or more non-target lesion(s) and/or maintenance of tumor marker levels above the normal limits. (RECIST)
Persistence of one or more non-target lesion(s) without unequivocal progression following an initial apparent radiographic progression.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Non iRECIST Complete Response-Non iRECIST Unconfirmed Progressive Disease

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: Following a previous assessment of progressive disease unconfirmed (PDu) of non-target lesion(s), the subsequent required assessment does not confirm progressive disease.
Presence of non-quantifiable minimal residual disease based on laboratory techniques.
An indication that the subject's steroid dose is the same as their physiologic replacement dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: No Steroid Use Beyond Physiologic Replacement Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: Not all target lesions were assessed. Or not all non-target lesions were assessed.
Remission with remaining lymphoid nodules reflecting residual disease.
No apparent change or worsening in lesion staging classification.
Hypo-attenuation of the metastases which may appear pseudocystic, perfectly homogeneous, and devoid of a recognizable peripheral rim.
Mixed attenuation and some homogeneity of the metastases with a partially resolved peripheral rim.
The disappearance of all signs of cancer, supported by pathological examination.
A disease process that is increasing in extent or severity. (NCI)
Disease progression occurring after a partial response.
There is an increase in the size and extent of tissue involvement by cancer, based on CT scan and criteria-defined assessments.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Progression or Relapse After Hematologic Improvement
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: Disease progression or the return of a disease after a period of remission, occurring after a hematologic improvement.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Progression or Relapse After Hematologic Improvement

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: A disease process that is increasing in scope or severity but the criteria for progressive disease is not met.
An increase of metabolic tumor activity in all relevant lesions, based on pre-defined thresholds, or the development of new lesions.
A decrease of metabolic tumor activity in all relevant lesions, based on a pre-defined threshold.
A finding indicating that there is a decrease based on a predetermined threshold in the size and the extent of tissue involvement by cancer.
A decrease in the size and the extent of tissue involvement by cancer, accompanied by an increase in blood lymphocyte count above a predetermined threshold.
A decrease in the size and extent of tissue involvement by cancer, based on CT scan and criteria-defined assessments.
The amount of prostate specific antigen is increased, based on pre-defined thresholds.
Apparent increase in lesion burden, not proven to be disease progression.
Apparent decrease in lesion burden, not proven to be favorable treatment response.
Presence of quantifiable minimal residual disease based on laboratory techniques.
The return of a disease after a period of remission.
The return of a disease after a period of complete remission.

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: RELAPSED DISEASE FROM CR OR PR
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Relapsed Disease From Complete Response or Partial Response
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The return of a disease after a period of complete remission or partial remission.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Relapsed Disease From Complete or Partial Response

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The confirmed disappearance of all signs of cancer, and absence of molecular or cytogenetic marker of disease, in response to treatment with additional biochemical, immunological and histopathological analyses to verify the CR.
Cancer that is neither decreasing nor increasing in extent or severity based on predetermined boundaries. (NCI)
The size and extent of tissue involvement by cancer is neither decreasing nor increasing, based on CT scan and criteria-defined assessments.
The absence of change or mild changes of metabolic tumor activity in all relevant lesions based on a pre-defined threshold.
Subject to little fluctuation; showing little if any change. (NCI)
The lack of expected or desired effect related to a therapy. (NCI)
Leaving no doubt; not open to question. (NCI)

An increase in lesion size, based on a pre-defined threshold, or the development of new lesion(s), marked central fill-in of a lesion, or new enhancement of a previously homogeneously hypoattenuating nonenhancing mass.
Partial response with additional serum and urine M-protein reduction, but not meeting complete response.
In a declining condition or state.

CodeList.Name: PK Parameters

Description.TranslatedText: Parameters used to describe the time-concentration curve.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The fraction of the treatment dose that reaches the systemic circulation; this is the ratio of the amount of drug in the system (area under the curve) after extravascular administration of a test formulation divided by the drug in the system (area under the curve) after IV administration.

The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration divided by the area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration during the initial dosing interval.

The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration divided by the area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration during the initial dosing interval.

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Accum Ratio AUC T1 to T2 norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio AUC T1 to T2 norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve from T1 to T2 at steady state divided by the area under the curve from T1 to T2 during the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio AUC T1 to T2 Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Accum Ratio AUC to Last Nonzero Conc
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio AUC to Last Nonzero Conc
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the last measurable concentration divided by the area under the curve from the time of dosing to the last measurable concentration during the initial dosing interval.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio AUC to Last Nonzero Concentration

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Accum Ratio AUCIFO Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio AUCIFO Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration divided by the area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration during the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio AUC Infinity Observed Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Accum Ratio AUCIFP Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio AUCIFP Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration divided by the area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration during the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio AUC Infinity Predicted Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Accum Ratio AUCTAU norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio AUCTAU norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUCTAU) at steady state divided by the area under the curve (AUCTAU) over the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio AUC Over Dosing Interval Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Accum Ratio Cmax norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio Cmax norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The maximum concentration at steady state divided by the maximum concentration during the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio Cmax Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Accum Ratio Cmin norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio Cmin norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The minimum concentration at steady state divided by the minimum concentration during the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio Cmin Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Accum Ratio Ctrough norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio Ctrough norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The trough concentration at steady state divided by the trough concentration during the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio Ctrough Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: Predicted accumulation ratio for area under the curve (AUC) calculated using the Lambda z estimated from single dose data.

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Accumulation Ratio AUC from T1 to T2
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accumulation Ratio AUC from T1 to T2
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve from T1 to T2 at steady state divided by the area under the curve from T1 to T2 during the initial dosing interval.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio Area Under the Curve from T1 to T2

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve over the dosing interval at steady state divided by the area under the curve over the initial dosing interval.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio Area Under the Curve

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The maximum concentration at steady state divided by the maximum concentration during the initial dosing interval.
The minimum concentration at steady state divided by the minimum concentration during the initial dosing interval.
The trough concentration at steady state divided by the trough concentration during the initial dosing interval.

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Amt Rec from T1 to T2
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec from T1 to T2
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC over the interval from T1 to T2.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered from T1 to T2

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Amt Rec from T1 to T2 Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec from T1 to T2 Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC over the interval from T1 to T2 divided by body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered from T1 to T2 Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Amt Rec from T1 to T2 Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec from T1 to T2 Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC over the interval from T1 to T2 divided by surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered from T1 to T2 Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Amt Rec from T1 to T2 Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec from T1 to T2 Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC over the interval from T1 to T2 divided by weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered from T1 to T2 Normalized by Weight

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration.

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Amt Rec Infinity Obs Norm by SA

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered Infinity Observed Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Amt Rec Infinity Obs Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec Infinity Obs Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered Infinity Observed Normalized by Weight

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration.

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Amt Rec Infinity Pred Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec Infinity Pred Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered Infinity Predicted Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Amt Rec Infinity Pred Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec Infinity Pred Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered Infinity Predicted Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Amt Rec Infinity Pred Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec Infinity Pred Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered Infinity Predicted Normalized by Weight

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC between doses (TAU).

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Amt Rec Over Dosing Interval Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec Over Dosing Interval Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC between doses (TAU) divided by body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered Over Dosing Interval Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Amt Rec Over Dosing Interval Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec Over Dosing Interval Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC between doses (TAU) divided by surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered Over Dosing Interval Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Amt Rec Over Dosing Interval Norm by WT

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC between doses (TAU) divided by weight.

EnumeratedItem.CodedValue: Amt Rec to Last Nonzero Conc
EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec to Last Nonzero Conc
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC, from the time of dosing to the last non-zero concentration.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered to Last Nonzero Concentration

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The total apparent clearance of the unbound fraction of drug, adjusted for bioavailability.

Applies only for intravascular bolus dosing. The area under the curve (AUC) from the first measured concentration value back extrapolated to the concentration value at time zero as a percentage of the area under the curve extrapolated to infinity using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Observed Area Under the Curve Percent Back Extrapolation

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: Applies only for intravascular bolus dosing. The area under the curve (AUC) from the first measured concentration value back extrapolated to the concentration value at time zero as a percentage of the area under the curve extrapolated to infinity using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Predicted Area Under the Curve Percent Back Extrapolation

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) from the last observed non-zero concentration value to infinity as a percentage of the area under the curve extrapolated to infinity.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Observed Area Under the Curve Percent Extrapolation

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) from the last predicted non-zero concentration value to infinity as a percentage of the area under the curve extrapolated to infinity.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the time of the last observation, regardless of whether the last concentration is measurable or not.
The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the time of the last observation divided by the body mass index, regardless of whether the last concentration is measurable or not.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the time of the last observation divided by the dose, regardless of whether the last concentration is measurable or not.

EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC All Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the time of the last observation divided by the weight, regardless of whether the last concentration is measurable or not.
The area under the curve (AUC) over the interval from T1 to T2.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Area Under the Curve from T1 to T2

CodeList.CDISCSynonym: PK Parameters
CodeList.PreferredTerm: CDISC SDTM Pharmacokinetic Parameter Long Name Terminology

CodeList.Name: PK Parameters Code

Description.TranslatedText: Parameter codes used to describe the time-concentration curve.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: Predicted accumulation ratio for area under the curve (AUC) calculated using the Lambda z estimated from single dose data.
The area under the curve over the dosing interval at steady state divided by the area under the curve over the initial dosing interval.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio Area Under the Curve

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio AUCTAU norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUCTAU) at steady state divided by the area under the curve (AUCTAU) over the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio AUC Over Dosing Interval Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration divided by the area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration during the initial dosing interval.

The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration divided by the area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration during the initial dosing interval.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio AUC T1 to T2 norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve from T1 to T2 at steady state divided by the area under the curve from T1 to T2 during the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio AUC T1 to T2 Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accumulation Ratio AUC from T1 to T2
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve from T1 to T2 at steady state divided by the area under the curve from T1 to T2 during the initial dosing interval.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio Area Under the Curve from T1 to T2

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio AUCIFO Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration divided by the area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration during the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio AUC Infinity Observed Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio AUCIFP Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration divided by the area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration during the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio AUC Infinity Predicted Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio AUC to Last Nonzero Conc
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the last measurable concentration divided by the area under the curve from the time of dosing to the last measurable concentration during the initial dosing interval.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio AUC to Last Nonzero Concentration

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The maximum concentration at steady state divided by the maximum concentration during the initial dosing interval.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio Cmax norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The maximum concentration at steady state divided by the maximum concentration during the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio Cmax Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The minimum concentration at steady state divided by the minimum concentration during the initial dosing interval.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio Cmin norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The minimum concentration at steady state divided by the minimum concentration during the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio Cmin Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Accum Ratio Ctrough norm by dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The trough concentration at steady state divided by the trough concentration during the initial dosing interval, each divided by the associated dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Accumulation Ratio Ctrough Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The trough concentration at steady state divided by the trough concentration during the initial dosing interval.
The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the time of the last observation, regardless of whether the last concentration is measurable or not.
The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the time of the last observation divided by the body mass index, regardless of whether the last concentration is measurable or not.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC All Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the time of the last observation divided by the dose, regardless of whether the last concentration is measurable or not.
The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the time of the last observation divided by the surface area, regardless of whether the last concentration is measurable or not.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC All Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the time of the last observation divided by the weight, regardless of whether the last concentration is measurable or not.
The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Observed Area Under the Curve Infinity

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC Infinity Obs Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC Infinity Observed Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC Infinity Obs Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC Infinity Observed Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC Infinity Obs Norm by Dose/WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration divided by the body weight-adjusted dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC Infinity Observed Normalized by Weight-Adjusted Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The natural log transformed area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Natural Log Transformed Observed Area Under the Curve Infinity

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC Infinity Obs Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC Infinity Observed Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The portion of observed AUC to infinity, represented by the unbound fraction of drug.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Observed Area Under the Curve Infinity of Unbound Drug

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC Infinity Obs Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC Infinity Observed Normalized by Weight

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Predicted Area Under the Curve Infinity

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC Infinity Pred Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC Infinity Predicted Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC Infinity Pred Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Predicted Area Under the Curve Infinity by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC Infinity Pred Norm by Dose per Body Weight
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration divided by the body weight-adjusted dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC Infinity Predicted Normalized by Weight-Adjusted Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC Infinity Pred Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC Infinity Predicted Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The portion of predicted AUC to infinity, represented by the unbound fraction of drug.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Predicted Area Under the Curve Infinity of Unbound Drug

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC Infinity Pred Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC Infinity Predicted Normalized by Weight

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) over the interval from T1 to T2.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Area Under the Curve from T1 to T2

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC from T1 to T2 Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) over the interval from T1 to T2 divided by the body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC from T1 to T2 Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC from T1 to T2 Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) over the interval from T1 to T2 divided by the dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC from T1 to T2 Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC from T1 to T2 Norm by Dose per Body Weight
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) over the interval from T1 to T2 divided by the body weight-adjusted dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC from T1 to T2 Normalized by Weight-Adjusted Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC from T1 to T2 Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) over the interval from T1 to T2 divided by the surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC from T1 to T2 Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC from T1 to T2 Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) over the interval from T1 to T2 divided by the weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC from T1 to T2 Normalized by Weight

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the last measurable concentration.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Area Under the Curve From Dosing to Last Concentration

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC to Last Nonzero Conc Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the last measurable concentration divided by the body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC Dosing to Last Concentration Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: AUC to Last Nonzero Conc Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The area under the curve (AUC) from the time of dosing to the last measurable concentration divided by the dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: AUC Dosing to Last Concentration Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Total Clearance Predicted Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Total CL Pred Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The total body clearance for intravascular administration, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Total Clearance Predicted Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Total CL Pred for Unbound Drug
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The total body clearance for intravascular administration divided by the fraction of drug unbound, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Total Clearance Predicted for Unbound Drug

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Total CL Pred Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The total body clearance for intravascular administration, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration, divided by the weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Total Clearance Predicted Normalized by Weight

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Renal CL as Pct CL EV
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The portion of total clearance attributed to the kidneys expressed as a percentage, following extravascular administration.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Renal Clearance to Total Clearance Ratio Measurement After Oral Dosing

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Renal CL as Pct CL IV
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The portion of total clearance attributed to the kidneys expressed as a percentage, following intravenous administration.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Renal Clearance to Total Clearance Ratio Measurement After Intravenous Dosing

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The concentration corresponding to Tlast.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Last Nonzero Conc Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The concentration corresponding to Tlast divided by the body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Last Concentration Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Last Nonzero Conc Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The concentration corresponding to Tlast divided by the dose.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Last Nonzero Conc Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The concentration corresponding to Tlast divided by the surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Last Concentration Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Last Nonzero Conc Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The concentration corresponding to Tlast divided by the weight.
The total body clearance for intravascular administration, calculated using AUCTAU.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Total Body Clearance for Dose Interval

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Total CL for Dose Int Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The total body clearance for intravascular administration, calculated using AUCTAU, divided by the body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Total Body Clearance for Dose Interval Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Total CL for Dose Int Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The total body clearance for intravascular administration, calculated using AUCTAU, divided by the dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Total Body Clearance for Dose Interval Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Total CL for Dose Int Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The total body clearance for intravascular administration, calculated using AUCTAU, divided by the surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Total Body Clearance for Dose Interval Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Total CL for Dose Int Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The total body clearance for intravascular administration, calculated using AUCTAU, divided by the weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Total Body Clearance for Dose Interval Normalized by Weight

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The maximum concentration occurring at Tmax.
The maximum concentration occurring at Tmax, divided by the body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Maximum Concentration Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The maximum concentration occurring at Tmax, divided by the dose.
The maximum concentration occurring at Tmax divided by the body weight-adjusted dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Maximum Concentration Normalized by Weight-Adjusted Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The natural log transformed maximum concentration occurring at Tmax.
The maximum concentration occurring at Tmax, divided by the surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Maximum Concentration Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The maximum concentration represented by the unbound fraction of drug, occurring at Tmax.
The maximum concentration occurring at Tmax, divided by the weight.
The minimum concentration between dose time and dose time plus Tau (at Tmin).
The minimum concentration between dose time and dose time plus Tau (at Tmin) divided by the body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Minimum Concentration Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The minimum concentration between dose time and dose time plus Tau (at Tmin) divided by the dose.
The minimum concentration between dose time and dose time plus Tau (at Tmin) divided by the body weight-adjusted dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Minimum Concentration Normalized by Weight-Adjusted Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The minimum concentration between dose time and dose time plus Tau (at Tmin) divided by the surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Minimum Concentration Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The minimum concentration between dose time and dose time plus Tau (at Tmin) divided by the weight.
The quantity of a specified substance in a unit volume or weight of another substance.
The concentration divided by body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Concentration Divided by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The concentration divided by dose.
The quantity of a specified substance in a unit volume or weight of another substance divided by the body weight-adjusted dose.
The concentration divided by surface area.
The concentration divided by weight.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Correlation Between TimeX and Log ConcY
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The correlation between time (X) and log concentration (Y) for the points used in the estimation of lambda z.
Concentration at end of dosing interval.
The trough concentration divided by body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Trough Concentration Divided by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The trough concentration divided by dose.
The trough concentration divided by surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Trough Concentration Divided by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The trough concentration divided by weight.
Half-life calculated from the distributional phase.
The drug half-life that quantifies the accumulation ratio of a drug following multiple dosing.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Excret Rate from T1 to T2
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The excretion rate over the interval from T1 to T2, determined for the specimen type specified in PPSPEC.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Excretion Rate From T1 to T2

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Excret Rate from T1 to T2 Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The excretion rate over the interval from T1 to T2 divided by the body mass index, determined for the specimen type specified in PPSPEC.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Excretion Rate From T1 to T2 Normalized by BMI

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Excret Rate from T1 to T2 Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The excretion rate over the interval from T1 to T2 divided by the dose, determined for the specimen type specified in PPSPEC.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Excretion Rate From T1 to T2 Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Excret Rate from T1 to T2 Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The excretion rate over the interval from T1 to T2 divided by the surface area, determined for the specimen type specified in PPSPEC.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Excretion Rate From T1 to T2 Normalized by SA

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Excret Rate from T1 to T2 Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The excretion rate over the interval from T1 to T2 divided by the weight, determined for the specimen type specified in PPSPEC.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Excretion Rate From T1 to T2 Normalized by WT

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The last measurable (positive) excretion rate determined for the specimen type specified in PPSPEC.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Last Meas Excretion Rate Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The last measurable (positive) excretion rate divided by the body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Last Measurable Excretion Rate Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Last Meas Excretion Rate Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The last measurable (positive) excretion rate divided by the dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Last Measurable Excretion Rate Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Last Meas Excretion Rate Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The last measurable (positive) excretion rate divided by the surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Last Measurable Excretion Rate Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Last Meas Excretion Rate Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The last measurable (positive) excretion rate divided by the weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Last Measurable Excretion Rate Normalized by Weight

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The maximum excretion rate determined for the specimen type specified in PPSPEC.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Max Excretion Rate Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The maximum excretion rate divided by the body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Maximum Observed Excretion Rate Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Max Excretion Rate Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The maximum excretion rate divided by the dose.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Maximum Observed Excretion Rate Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Max Excretion Rate Norm by SA
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The maximum excretion rate divided by the surface area.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Maximum Observed Excretion Rate Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Max Excretion Rate Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The maximum excretion rate divided by the weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Maximum Observed Excretion Rate Normalized by Weight

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Midpoint of Interval of Last Nonzero ER
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The midpoint of collection interval associated with last measurable excretion rate.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Midpoint of Interval of Maximum ER
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The midpoint of collection interval associated with the maximum excretion rate.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Time of Maximum Observed Excretion Rate

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The fraction of the treatment dose that reaches the systemic circulation; this is the ratio of the amount of drug in the system (area under the curve) after extravascular administration of a test formulation divided by the drug in the system (area under the curve) after IV administration.
The ratio of bound drug concentration to the total concentration.
The difference between Cmin and Cmax standardized to Cavg, between dose time and Tau.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Concentration Variability Between Dose Time and Tau

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The fraction of the treatment dose that reaches the systemic circulation relative to a reference route or reference formulation. The ratio of the amount of drug in the system (area under the curve) after administration of a test formulation divided by the drug in the system after a non-IV administration of a reference formulation and/or reference route.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Fract Excr from T1 to T2
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The fraction of the administered dose that is recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC, over the interval between T1 and T2.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Fractional Excretion from T1 to T2

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The ratio of free drug concentration to the total concentration. (NCI)
The clearance of a substance from the blood during a hemodialysis session.
The fractional content of a substance removed from the blood during a hemodialysis session.
The midpoint time between dosing time and Tmax.
The distribution rate constant.
The first order rate constant associated with the terminal (log-linear) portion of the curve.
Terminal half-life.
The lower limit on time for values to be included in the calculation of Lambda z.
The lower limit on time for values to be included in the calculation of Lambda z, calculated within a dosing interval.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Number of Points for Lambda z
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The number of time points used in computing Lambda z.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Number of Points for Lambda z TAU
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The number of time points used in computing Lambda z determined in a dosing interval.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Number of Points for Lambda z TAU

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The interval of time covered by the data points used in the terminal disposition phase regression analysis, divided by half life. This yields the terminal disposition phase duration expressed as the number of half lives.
The first order rate constant associated with the terminal (log-linear) portion of the curve, calculated within a dosing interval.
The upper limit on time for values to be included in the calculation of Lambda z.
The upper limit on time for values to be included in the calculation of Lambda z, calculated within a dosing interval.
Mean absorption time of a substance administered by extravascular dosing.

The mean residence time (MRT) extrapolated to infinity for a substance administered by extravascular dosing, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration. Extravascular MRT includes Mean Absorption Time (MAT).
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Mean Residence Time Infinity Observed by Extravascular Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The mean residence time (MRT) extrapolated to infinity for a substance administered by extravascular dosing, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration. Extravascular MRT includes Mean Absorption Time (MAT).
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Mean Residence Time Infinity Predicted by Extravascular Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: MRT Extravasc to Last Nonzero Conc
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: Mean residence time (MRT) from the time of dosing to the time of the last measurable concentration for a substance administered by extravascular dosing. Extravascular MRT includes Mean Absorption Time (MAT).
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Mean Residence Time to Last Nonzero Concentration by Extravascular Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The mean residence time (MRT) extrapolated to infinity for a substance administered by intravascular dosing, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Mean Residence Time Infinity Observed by Intravascular Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The mean residence time (MRT) extrapolated to infinity for a substance administered by intravascular dosing, calculated using the predicted value of the last non-zero concentration.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Mean Residence Time Infinity Predicted by Intravascular Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: MRT Intravasc to Last Nonzero Conc
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: Mean residence time (MRT) from the time of dosing to the time of the last measurable concentration, for a substance administered by intravascular dosing.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Mean Residence Time to Last Nonzero Concentration by Intravascular Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The total clearance of a substance from the blood less the renal clearance.
The total clearance of a substance from the blood minus the renal clearance divided by the body mass index.
The total clearance of a substance from the blood minus the renal clearance divided by the dose.
The total clearance of a substance from the blood minus the renal clearance divided by the surface area.
The total clearance of a substance from the blood minus the renal clearance divided by the weight.
The maximum concentration during a dosing interval divided by the concentration at the end of the dosing interval.
The goodness of fit statistic for the terminal elimination phase.
The goodness of fit statistic for the terminal elimination phase, adjusted for the number of time points used in the estimation of Lambda z.
The ratio of two AUC values.
The ratio of two AUC All values.
The ratio of two AUC infinity observed values.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Area Under the Curve Ratio Infinity Observed

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The ratio of two AUC infinity predicted values.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Area Under the Curve Ratio Infinity Predicted

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Ratio AUC from T1 to T2 Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The ratio of two AUC from T1 to T2 normalized by dose values.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Ratio AUC from T1 to T2 Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Ratio AUC from T1 to T2
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The ratio of two AUC from T1 to T2 values.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Ratio AUC From T1 to T2

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Ratio AUC Infinity Obs Norm by Dose

EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Ratio AUC Infinity Observed Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The ratio of two AUC to last nonzero concentration normalized by dose values.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Ratio AUC to Last Nonzero Concentration Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Ratio AUC to Last Nonzero Conc
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The ratio of two AUC to last nonzero concentration values.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Ratio AUC to Last Nonzero Concentration

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The ratio of two AUCTAU values.
The ratio of two average concentration values.
The ratio of two Cmax values.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Ratio Max Conc Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The ratio of two maximum concentration normalized by dose values.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Ratio Maximum Concentration Normalized by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The ratio of two cmin values.
The ratio of two concentration values.
The ratio of two CTROUGH values.
The ratio of Cmax value to Cmin value.
The ratio of two amount recovered infinity observed values.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Ratio Amt Rec from T1 to T2
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The ratio of two amount recovered from T1 to T2 values.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Ratio Amount Recovered from T1 to T2

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration.

EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered Infinity Observed Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec Infinity Obs Norm by SA

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec Infinity Obs Norm by WT

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec Infinity Pred Norm by BMI

EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered Infinity Predicted Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec Infinity Pred Norm by SA

EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered Infinity Predicted Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered from T1 to T2

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC, from the time of dosing to the last non-zero concentration.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered to Last Nonzero Concentration

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC between doses (TAU).

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec Over Dosing Interval Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC between doses (TAU) divided by body mass index.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec Over Dosing Interval Norm by SA

EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered Over Dosing Interval Normalized by Surface Area

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Amt Rec Over Dosing Interval Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The cumulative amount recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC between doses (TAU) divided by weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Amount Recovered Over Dosing Interval Normalized by Weight

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The percentage of the administered dose that is recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC extrapolated to infinity, calculated using the observed value of the last non-zero concentration.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Pct Rec Infinity Obs Norm by BMI

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Pct Rec from T1 to T2
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The percentage of the administered dose that is recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC, over the interval between T1 and T2.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Pct Rec from T1 to T2 Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The percentage of the administered dose that is recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC, over the interval between T1 and T2 divided by body mass index.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Pct Rec Over Dosing Interval Norm by WT
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The percentage of the administered dose that is recovered from the specimen type specified in PPSPEC, between doses (TAU) divided by weight.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The clearance of a substance from the blood by the kidneys.
The clearance of a substance from the blood by the kidneys divided by the body mass index.
The clearance of a substance from the blood by the kidneys divided by the dose.
The clearance of a substance from the blood by the kidneys divided by the surface area.
The clearance of a substance from the blood by the kidneys divided by the weight.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The clearance of a substance from the blood by the kidneys over the interval from T1 to T2 divided by the body mass index.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Renal Clearance from T1 to T2 Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Renal CL from T1 to T2 Norm by Dose

EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Renal Clearance for Dose Interval Normalized by Body Mass Index

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Renal CL for Dose Int Norm by Dose
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The clearance of a substance from the blood by the kidneys, calculated using AUCTAU, divided by the dose.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The unbound fraction of drug within the portion of total clearance attributed to the kidneys.
The area under the curve (AUCTAU) at steady state divided by the area under the curve extrapolated to infinity for the initial dosing interval.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Stationarity Ratio Area Under the Curve

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The difference between Cmax and Cmin standardized to Cmin within a dosing interval.
The duration of time between two doses.
Half-life calculated within a dosing interval.
The time prior to the first measurable (non-zero) concentration.
The time of the last measurable (positive) concentration.
The time of maximum observed concentration sampled during a dosing interval.
The time of minimum concentration sampled during a dosing interval.
The concentration at the start of a dosing interval divided by the maximum concentration during the dosing interval.
The initial volume of distribution for a substance administered by bolus intravascular dosing.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Vol Dist Initial Norm by BMI
EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The initial volume of distribution for a substance administered by bolus intravascular dosing divided by the body mass index.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCSynonym: Vol Dist Initial Norm by Dose

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: The sum of urine volumes that are used for PK parameters.

Description.TranslatedText: Units of measure for pharmacokinetic data and parameters.

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: One hundred times the quotient of one quantity divided by another, with the same units of measurement.
Becquerel per gram, divided by dose per kilogram body weight or Becquerel per gram, divided by dose per gram body weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Becquerel per Gram per Kilobecquerel per Kilogram

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: Becquerel per milliliter, divided by dose per kilogram body weight or Becquerel per milliliter, divided by dose per gram body weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Becquerel per Milliliter per Kilobecquerel per Kilogram

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: Hours times Becquerel per gram (area under the curve), divided by dose per kilogram body weight or hours times Becquerel per gram (area under the curve), divided by dose per gram body weight.
EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Hour Times Becquerel per Gram per Kilobecquerel per Kilogram

EnumeratedItem.PreferredTerm: Hour Times Becquerel per Milliliter per Kilobecquerel per Kilogram

EnumeratedItem.CDISCDefinition: Liters per day (flow rate), divided by milligrams per day (daily dose) or milliliters per day (flow rate), divided by micrograms per day (daily dose).
